common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fantasy action-game combat status UI icon, square raster PNG, real transparent background. Make ONE compact original hand-painted synthetic-occult badge matching an aged-brass, charcoal and parchment game interface. A simple dark charcoal square inset with clipped bevelled corners and a restrained thin antique-brass rim; transparent outside the badge, no surrounding opaque square. Centered badge occupies about 86% of canvas width with clear transparent margins. The central symbol fills most of the inset and must read at 16-24 screen pixels: bold clean silhouette, a few broad painted material planes, bright controlled edges, large negative gaps, no fine engraving, no tiny particles. Flat front view, centered, no perspective. Not a sprite sheet or concept board. No letters, numbers, words, runes resembling text, captions, logos, characters, environment, checkerboard, broad bloom or cast shadows outside the badge.

asset_prompts.burn: Central symbol: one substantial vivid orange flame with two broad tongues rising around a small golden-ivory hot core. Strong red-orange silhouette with a broad dark inner cutout and restrained golden edge lights. Read unmistakably as BURNING at tiny scale, no smoke, candles or fireball trail.
asset_prompts.bleed: Central symbol: two large crimson blood droplets falling from a short diagonal ivory slash, with a broad dark gap between the drops. Rich red and warm scarlet edges. Read unmistakably as BLEEDING at tiny scale. No fangs, teeth, heart, realistic wound, gore or vampire ring.
asset_prompts.stun: Central symbol: one broken amber-gold halo around a compact ivory central impact spark, with three broad angular gold rays. Bold interrupted circular silhouette and dark separation, suggesting a dazed head or loss of control. Read as STUNNED at tiny scale. No face, numbers, punctuation marks or text glyphs.
asset_prompts.healing_sealed: Central symbol: one substantial violet-magenta heart held closed by a bold pale-lilac iron clasp crossing its centre diagonally. Clear purple heart silhouette and one contrasting clasp, broad dark internal separation. Read as HEALING SEALED / healing blocked at tiny scale. No letters, medical cross, gore or blood droplets.
asset_prompts.slow: Central symbol: one substantial icy-blue boot held down by a single heavy steel ankle shackle and one short hanging chain link. Bold blue boot silhouette, pale blue edges, large dark negative gaps. Read as SLOWED movement at tiny scale. No ice crystals, snowflakes or clock text.
asset_prompts.warded: Central symbol: one broad luminous turquoise protective arch sheltering a small solid ivory core, with two substantial upward shield shoulders. Bright cyan-turquoise face planes and pale edge lights, dark open space underneath the arch. Read as a temporary protective WARD at tiny scale. No wide aura ring or hexagonal elite shield.
asset_prompts.haste: Central symbol: one vivid emerald-green swept wing formed from three broad feathers pointing right, with a short ivory-green forward streak. Compact solid wing silhouette with broad dark separations and pale mint edge lights. Read as temporary HASTE at tiny scale. No yellow chevrons, characters or full bird.
asset_prompts.fading: Central symbol: one slate-lavender ghostlike wisp dissolving into exactly three broad separated fragments to its right. Compact pale grey-purple core, one larger dark cutout and cool lavender edge lights; bold silhouette, dark negative gaps. Read as FADING / withering away at tiny scale. No skull detail, smoke cloud or particles.
asset_prompts.execution_mark: Central symbol: one vivid red angular targeting diamond held between four thick crimson bracket corners, with one small ivory dagger point in its center. Bold precise red target silhouette with large dark negative gaps. Read as an execution MARK at tiny scale. No letters, runic writing or fine crosshair graduations.
asset_prompts.wound: Central symbol: one substantial dark-crimson heart split by a single broad ivory diagonal cutting gash, with scarlet edge highlights and deep dark separation along the cut. Simple bold WOUNDED symbol at tiny scale. No blood droplets, fangs, lock, medical cross or realistic gore.
asset_prompts.jam: Central symbol: one dark gun barrel opening blocked by a substantial vivid red-orange wedge, with a short angular red crossed obstruction bar. Bold compact mechanical JAM silhouette, hot coral metal faces and ivory-red edges, large dark gaps. Read as a jammed weapon / firing blocked at tiny scale. No bullet trail, explosion, letters or ammunition count.
asset_prompts.debt: Central symbol: one violet-purple hourglass holding a single large antique-gold coin in its lower bulb, with pale lavender edge lights. Thick compact hourglass frame, simple gold disc, broad dark internal gaps. Read as delayed DEBT coming due at tiny scale. No currency letters, numbers, text, fine grains of sand or inscriptions.
asset_prompts.anchored: Central symbol: one substantial pale icy-blue anchor with a broad curved base and clear ivory-blue top loop, planted firmly on one short dark steel ground bar. Strong stable silhouette, three broad material planes, large dark gaps. Read as ANCHORED stability at tiny scale. No rope coil, ocean, chain clutter or writing.
asset_prompts.marked: Central symbol: one substantial violet-purple faceted diamond suspended inside a compact pair of open lavender crescent brackets, with an ivory-lilac center light. Bold mystical target silhouette, broad negative gaps. Read as the Manifestation MARK at tiny scale. No red execution reticle, dagger, letters, runes, detailed sigil or sparks.
asset_prompts.scarred: Central symbol: one broad red-bronze armour plate reinforced across its centre by three substantial short ivory-red stitches over a single dark healed seam. Strong compact defensive plate silhouette, warm coral face planes, clear broad reinforcement. Read as SCAR armour at tiny scale. No blood droplets, gore, needle, letters or fine stitching.
asset_prompts.cracked: Central symbol: one substantial bronze-gold breastplate broken into two angular halves by a single broad black vertical crack. Warm amber metal face planes, ivory-gold edge lights and a clearly open fracture. Read as ARMOUR CRACKED at tiny scale. No blood, lightning cloud or intact blue armour.
asset_prompts.prime: Central symbol: one bold pale-gold dagger blade poised diagonally inside a compact orange-gold crescent of stored force. Large ivory blade, amber rim, one broad dark gap between blade and arc. Read as PRIMED for the next strike at tiny scale. No clock, flame, text or tiny sparks.
asset_prompts.weak_point: Central symbol: one ivory-white open target diamond with four thick separated corners surrounding a warm gold exposed central dot. Very pale ivory and soft gold, bold dark gaps; read as an EXPOSED WEAK POINT at tiny scale. No red execution dagger, numbers, eye detail, text or fine reticle graduations.
asset_prompts.fracture: Central symbol: one vivid orange faceted stone fractured into three substantial separated chunks by a broad dark zigzag, with pale amber edge lights. Bold impact-shattered silhouette, broad orange face planes. Read as FRACTURED by a blast at tiny scale. No green crystal, full armour plate, flame cloud or fine debris.
asset_prompts.link: Central symbol: two substantial violet-purple chain links locked diagonally together, with broad lavender edge lights and large dark hollow centres. Bold interlinked silhouette with one clear crossing. Read as LINKED enemies at tiny scale. No chain extending outside badge, letters or tiny links.
asset_prompts.blood_rite: Central symbol: one dark-rose and crimson shallow ritual chalice holding a single large red drop above its bowl, with pale pink edge lights. Strong compact cup-and-drop silhouette, three broad planes, dark negative gap. Read as BLOOD RITE at tiny scale. No engraving, letters, runes, realistic gore or fangs.
